newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Brent supported, readying for new up move.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Brent supported, readying for new up move.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+ New front month July Brent is well supported and is readying for the next up move - with resistance at $19.87-$19.89.
+ Gas oil faces an upside test at $174.75 - the high of this month's up move and next to the $174.80 Fibonacci 38 percent retracement.
IPE Brent crude oil futures are expected to ready themselves for another push upwards in the coming sessions and resistance is anticipated at $19.60 and then $19.89.
July Brent, the new front month, closed six cents a barrel lower on Thursday at $19.49, compared with June's expiry at $19.44.
June gas oil closed $1.25 up at $172.00.
"It seems to be consolidating at these levels but I expect it will push upwards again in the next few sessions," said Darren Gurner at Sucden in London.

He said the 50 percent Fibonacci retracement from the moves from the January highs and the low point since then was $19.87, which lies next to the $19.89 high reached on the continuation chart on Monday.
"It is well supported at the gap from $18.80-$18.88 on the July chart."

MeesPierson Derivatives in London, employing their Market Profile technique, saw "a pretty good lid on the market" at $19.60. Resistance above that level lay at $19.84, they said, while support would be found at $19.36 and $19.12.
"A break of $19.12 and we could see $18.84."
